newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen higher at open in followthrough.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen higher at open in followthrough.

text.p: The Dow Industrials are expected to head higher at the opening in a mild followthrough to Tuesday blue chip rally.
But analysts said greater participation from the broad market and a steady bond market were prerequisites for sustained strength in today's trading.

"We're going to open on a mild note," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "We will probably follow through on a tentative basis. The rally yesterday was in the Dow. Breadth was even keel."

"I think we are going to see a narrow range here," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments. "We'll be up five to 10 points at the open and then dip, with another reversal later in the day."
He said that there was an increasing amount of bearish sentiment in the market, which lae him to believe that trading would be a "sideways affair."

"I think the market will break with tradition," he said. "I don't think a Santa Claus rally is in the making. There are a lot of nervous people in the market, and I don't see anything to motivate them at this point."
